name: SIGMA - Domain Group Discovery via Net.exe [threshold]
description: Elastic threshold companion for rules/sigma/proc_creation_win_domain_group_discovery.yml (issue #217). The Sigma rule is already level:low (single-event, no timeframe, floods on help-desk/IAM administration) and stays that way for hunting/correlation - a single deliberate execution by an attacker still needs to be recorded. This threshold rule adds the higher-severity signal for what actually distinguishes automated recon tooling from routine account administration: domain group enumeration executed repeatedly on the SAME host within a short window.
author: Suburban-SOC
false_positives: A help-desk or IAM administration script that legitimately enumerates domain groups more than once against the same host in a short window.
